description: Count business days between two dates in a country (and region), excluding weekends and public holidays. The end date is excluded unless inclusive is true. Returns business, weekend and holiday day counts and the holidays in the range. Read-only. Same engine, cache and limits as GET /v1/between.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, DE, GB. See list_countries.

inclusive.description: Count the end date too (default false).

region.description: Optional region/state code for countries with regional holidays, e.g. DE-BY, US-CA (or just BY).

types.description: Optional holiday types that close business days: comma list of public, bank (default: public; "all" = public,bank).

weekend.description: Optional weekend days, comma list of day names like "sat,sun" (default) or "fri,sat", or "none".

name: business_days_between
title: Count business days between two dates
